dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical 2D narrowing observed from the mid-dorsal region toward the posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Slate dark-grey median pixel intensity across the visible dorsal area.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Sharp, high-contrast gradient between the dark-grey epidermal baseline and the light-colored linear markings.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Multiple high-contrast, light-colored linear marks (rake marks) on the posterior dorsal plane.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent, multi-directional linear rake marks visible across the posterior third of the dorsal surface.
other_distinctive_markers: The blowhole is clearly visible as a dark, circular aperture on the anterior dorsal midline.
